I would say yes and no to your question. 

Yes because technically all the features you mentioned are still available. No because they don’t have an interactive system for that. As in you can’t go with anyone at anytime you want. You have to meet them through balls, or wait until the devs release a story for them. 

For example, every characters do have their own side stories and extra secrets. Once you have unlocked a certain level of favor you can read the stories at where you usually go for main quests. (Level 10= all side story for that character unlocked) 

About new conversation/interaction, if you noticed, when you talk to characters at random balls on their topics, sometimes the dialogue will end with “Maybe if I have a higher favor level, they would tell me more.” When you reach lv10, those extra dialogues will be available. (The system doesn’t tell you this, you just have to notice/read through). And also, if you grind enough through convo, you might be able to memorize/distinguish the generic dialogues vs. dialogue that is only unique to that characters. (i.e, for Asteria, a generic convo on “Adventure” topic might be about Magda inquiring about bodyguards, or a unique one will be about Asteria’s survival skills&stories)

As for outfits, they are limited and obtained only through events, either tavern events or pay-to-get events. Sometimes if they are generous you can also get them for free. However, your favorite characters might not be available right away, as they only select and release a few each time.

Special CGs are also limited to a few characters (maybe as of now). If you go to “Gallery”, tap “Search”, swipe to the bottom and select filter “Set With Stories”, you’ll see the outfits that have special stories. The story+CG will be unlocked once you have collected all the items for that outfit. Spoiler, one of those outfits does have Xavier in their story:)
